policy: Source wording, option order, and printed answer keys are retained. No source key has been silently corrected. Blocking cases are segregated from all nine topic datasets.

blocking_issue_summary.issue: Malformed identity: the printed expression has a plus sign and no equals sign.
blocking_issue_summary.action: Preserve the printed expression/key; leave solution and mistakes empty.

blocking_issue_summary.issue: The two premises and conclusion referred to in the stem are missing.
blocking_issue_summary.action: Preserve the incomplete stem/key; do not fabricate missing statements.

blocking_issue_summary.issue: The source answer image matches option b, but a whole-word left-right mirror reflection appears to match option c instead. Mirror axis is not shown.
blocking_issue_summary.action: Preserve source key b and all option images; withhold an endorsed solution pending review.

scope_exclusions.reason: Language, literature, general knowledge, science, and factual recall; none requires an allowed quantitative/reasoning skill as its core step. A number appearing in a factual question is not sufficient.
Computer/ICT factual knowledge rather than numerical calculation or reasoning in the allowed taxonomy.
The number of female Nobel laureates is factual recall, not a number-system or mental-reasoning calculation. Not included merely because the answer is numerical.
IQ-category terminology, vocabulary relationship recall, and values/governance questions are outside the adopted quantitative/pattern/spatial/logical-reasoning scope.

classification_decisions.reason: Powers-of-two address counting and numeral-base conversion are the decisive calculations, even though the questions appear in the ICT portion.
Angle/trigonometry task mapped to geometry because the supplied nine-topic schema has no separate trigonometry category.

Broad arithmetic includes finite outcome counting/division and the multiplication principle. The demo does not separately name probability or permutations; this mapping is explicitly recorded rather than adding new topics.
The decisive step is recognising the Pythagorean relation, not manipulating the ratio itself.

Pattern recognition, signed-diagram reasoning, visual discrimination, ordinal coding, reflection, or logical conclusions. Pure factual/vocabulary recall is not automatically included because it occurs in the same exam section.
